record.title: Promoting the Use of Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence in the Federal Government (Executive Order 13960)
record.issuing_body: The White House (President Donald J. Trump)
record.summary: Sets nine principles for federal agencies' design, development, acquisition and use of AI outside national security and defense: lawful, purposeful, accurate and reliable, safe, secure and resilient, understandable, responsible and traceable, regularly monitored, transparent and accountable. It tasks OMB with policy guidance, requires agencies to inventory their AI use cases, and sets up interagency coordination and AI expertise.
record.notes: Signed 3 December 2020 and published in the Federal Register on 8 December 2020. It builds on Executive Order 13859. OMB memorandum M-26-04 of 11 December 2025 refers to it among the existing directives on agency AI use.

verification.note: Federal Register PDF from govinfo.gov stored and read. Current status rests on OMB memorandum M-26-04 (stored as an extra source), which cites the order as an existing directive.
